name: Soekarno-Hatta International Airport

runway.v: three runways: 3,600 x 60 m, 3,660 x 60 m and 3,000 x 60 m

notes: Indonesia's AIP (AirNav Indonesia) is not free to read online and was not opened; the FAA IFIM pointed to http://hubud.dephub.go.id/?en+page+detail+40, which could not be opened. Used the Ministry of Transportation DG Civil Aviation airport data page (runways, codes CGK/WIII; the page writes 3.660,00 with a decimal comma, i.e. 3,660 m) and the Airport Authority Office Region I profile ('24 Hours'). Neither page is dated. The two pages name the operator differently (PT. Angkasa Pura Indonesia vs PT. Angkasa Pura II). Customs/CIQ hours and slot rules not found.
